notes: GoatPro (GPRO) is an ERC-20 token with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints the entire fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. Transfers have no tax or burn, and the token exposes no further minting or administrative controls. The opening pool price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei and totalSupply; pool.initialPrice is provenance only.
